# Security

[![OpenSSF Scorecard](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/acme/edge/badge)](https://securityscorecards.dev/viewer/?uri=github.com/acme/edge)

We take security seriously.

If you believe you have found a vulnerability in Acme Edge, please get in touch
with the maintainers and we will look into it as soon as we can.

Please do not open a public issue for security problems.
